name: Screen zoom
description: The screen recording zooms in before each click and the view follows the pointer, then eases back out. The pointer zooms with the screen and can be the Mac arrow, a white dot or your own picture, at any size.
when: Screen demos where small buttons and text matter: tutorials, product walkthroughs, bug reports. Needs a screen take recorded with the cursor log (take-NN-screen.events.json) for auto and for following the pointer.
needs: a cut that shows a screen take (kind: screen)
auto: true, or your own zooms (spans) on what the voice talks about
optional: how close (level), the pointer's look and size
